g.text: Objective: give every holding today's mark: its intrinsic value, price, red flags, failed gates and sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC), each known or unknown.

text.tspan: it is a holding today
holdings = tickers whose summed quantity ≠ 0 on the snapshot date

g.text: its intrinsic value, price and red flags are known, or unknown
its failed gates and sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC) are known, or unknown

text.tspan: today's mark is stored
the snapshot date's rows deleted, then inserted; unknown values stored empty

g.text: the previous mark is read, or there is none
the analyze stage values the holding, see the analyze board
config/assumptions/TICKER.yaml, manual overrides when valuing a holding

text.tspan: config/currencies.yaml:
the currency table, loaded once per run
config/presets/damodaran_value.yaml:
its quality gates and trap detection gate every holding
Comes out:
one holding_marks row per holding for the snapshot date

g.text: it is held today [its summed quantity is not 0]

text.tspan: the valuator values it [a narrative flag is red]
intrinsic value per share, latest close, red narrative flags
the valuator values it [no narrative flag is red]
intrinsic value per share, latest close, red narrative flags
the valuator cannot value it, so all three stay unknown
[an unknown ticker, missing data or an error]
the gates are judged and the sector WACC is read [in companies, with a sector benchmark that has a WACC]
screener inputs built as the screen builds them; failed gates = the gates that fail; a skipped rule does not count; sector WACC from the sector benchmark
the gates are judged without a sector WACC [no sector benchmark, or no WACC in it]
failed gates = the gates that fail; a skipped rule does not count; sector WACC unknown
the gates and the sector WACC stay unknown [not in companies]
failed gates and sector WACC unknown
today's mark is stored, replacing any earlier mark of the day
one holding_marks row per holding; the snapshot date's rows deleted, then inserted; unknown values stored empty

g.text: the previous mark is read [it was marked then]
there is no previous mark [first run, or not marked then]
quality gates and trap detection rules

text.tspan: [always]
marks of the day
